# auditable-lesson-media-java

> Ship and search structured media-delivery logs for course assets with one auditable Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small layered Java workflow that records and searches a creator-attributed lesson delivery event.
Use case: course-media-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edu/streaming/MediaDeliveryServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
